use_cases: Hero section background for landing pages
Decorative animated mesh background for web apps
Visual accent for marketing websites and SaaS products
Interactive geometric background for media platforms
ai_summary: An interactive WebGL shader component rendering 3D geometric cubes with blur effects and gradient coloring. Features mouse-reactive animations and smooth 3D rotations using rotation matrices. The component creates a modern mesh-style background with perspective projection, ideal for hero sections and landing pages that need dynamic visual interest.
